scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @slowpoke/web typecheck && (cd apps/backend && uv run pyright)
scripts.lint:python: (cd apps/backend && uv run ruff check .) && (cd apps/collector && uv run ruff check .)
scripts.lint:python:fix: (cd apps/backend && uv run ruff check --fix .) && (cd apps/collector && uv run ruff check --fix .)
scripts.deptry: cd apps/backend && uv run deptry . && cd ../collector && uv run deptry .
scripts.format: oxfmt && (cd apps/backend && uv run ruff format .) && (cd apps/collector && uv run ruff format .)
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check && (cd apps/backend && uv run ruff format --check .) && (cd apps/collector && uv run ruff format --check .)
